card.text: Explore Calypso in 3D with Cassini imagery and its measured irregular shape.

introduction.text: Calypso follows Tethys around Saturn, about 60° behind the larger moon. Its elongated shape carries overlapping craters and unusually smooth, bright surface deposits.

normal.title: ISS mosaic
normal.summary: Brightness matching reduces photographed shading. The gray grid marks missing coverage and terrain hidden in cast shadows.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height relative to a 10.7 km sphere, from the Cassini shape model. Small craters are unresolved.
